title: Written incident report at Colonel Spraker's office, never given a copy
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: handed me these he handed me these forms he said I need you to write down every single thing that happened on that site tonight from the time you got this alarm to to the completion

plain: A nuclear weapons guard named Mario Woods says that in 1977, after a night incident at a missile site, he was called into a Colonel Spraker's office at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota and handed forms. He says he was told to "write down every single thing that happened on that site tonight from the time you got this alarm to the completion," but was never given a copy. Woods tells it as his own experience, also naming a Jack Reed, and it would mean an official written record of the night exists somewhere.
